authority: Inert pure value; no I/O, credential, device or store authority.
digits: Unsigned: every nibble 0..9. Signed: last nibble C for positive or D for negative; preceding nibbles 0..9. Negative zero is refused.
input: Exactly registers*2 Modbus network-order bytes, interpreted after explicit register-byte and word reordering.
output: WRT.06 decimal node; normalize nonzero coefficient trailing zeros into exponent, canonical zero exponent 0. Exponent overflow is unsupported_value.

refusals.invalid_input: Wrong width/configuration/metadata grammar or BCD digit/sign nibble.
refusals.output_limit: No success can exceed WRT.06 output limits.
refusals.unsupported_value: Negative zero or normalized exponent overflow.
